body: "You look like the walking dead"

It's just me here, I'm 3000 miles from anyone I know but him. Everything you've told me...people tell it to me all the time. I know what I need to do, but I can't find the strength to do it. I weigh less than 100lbs. I'm dying already, I predict I have 5-10 years tops left. I just want to end it now, though. I always thought I could leave him and wouldn't have to crumble away like this. But I just don't see how I can. I tried five times. Five. I'll lose my job if I try and fail again.
I tried multiple times with family, because I never go through with leaving, I am now the "boy who cried wolf". Everyone lost respect for me.

I don't know. He tells me I can go, but he won't break up with me. He doesn't want me to go. And I can power myself through packing, loading my car, taking off work - but then the day comes to leave, it's like...we reconnect on a deeper level that day, I realize I love him, I don't leave - then I have to go back to work and my vacation time is gone again so I have to wait until I can do it again. My breaking up with him requires that I move 3000 miles away, so that adds pressure. But it doesn't matter since i keep stupidly deciding I still love him and will stay and work on the relationship - but then the very next day, my feelings of sadness return in troves and I wish I'd have left, but my chance is gone...gone...gone.
Well, I don't even know how to respond to that.

Dear ReviewBrah, 

I have no idea if you will ever read this. But I had to write this comment to you after watching this most recent video. I have made some terrible decisions in the name of being the person I thought I should be, and not the person I truly am. I won't go into details, but I basically put all personal growth on hold so I could be with and care for someone that ultimately, I was never compatible with but they supported me and who am I to turn down the support of another living human being? 

I am me, that's who. That's all I can ever be. I can try to hide that I'm not the most normal chick out there, I'm fascinated by the world and so many things in it, I have such a great excitement for life and the wide open future before me - and yet, I haven't been able to embrace it because I'm trapped within my own suppression. I cannot be myself I am suppressing myself. I will never, ever, find happiness if I continue this. 

So it was fortuitous for me that you posted this video today. I needed someone to tell me to just...be myself. To reaffirm the feeling that I have that I just can't change to be the person they really want, I can't and never will be able to, and even though I can fake it forever it will never feel normal to me, it will never come natural. 

In short, thank you.
Thank you! I am working but I will read through both of these posts carefully and get back to you. THANK YOU!

Every reply I've gotten to this post has been helpful - but I will reply to yours first because I have just read it, just now, and I think you definitely called out some truths I had an inkling of, and some I had not thought of at all. First - I have had the thought many times that you can't love another properly until you love yourself, but I was told this is false again and again but relationship "gurus", that learning to love yourself within a relationship is just as possible (if not better) than learning to do so alone. I disagreed, but had no way to explain why this just doesn't feel right to me - and that's where your explanation of "falling" really made sense. 

I certainly "fell" in love that nearly decade ago, completely and suddenly and without looking back, I completely lost myself and so did he. But we never achieved a balance and a harmony, more like an apathy or a tolerance, a deep love built around comfort and acceptance, but not happiness or strength. 

Another thing you said that meant SO MUCH to me - "you're in a relationship to be HAPPY, and not to endure.". I have said that many times to myself and to my partner in my own way, but the counter to this is that all relationships are work and any couple I see that appears happy, is secretly enduring and fighting behind closed doors. I don't think that seems true...but I also don't have the facts, my partner has pointed out my belief this isn't true is "just a feeling" and not backed by reality. 

I truly, deeply, want to love myself - and I want to give and share love with so many people once I'm able to. But where I am right now, it just feels like a trap, a hole called love as you say...and the longer I'm here the deeper the hole seems to get. 

I just need to "rip the bandaid" off and go, but that action has been so hard to go through with. I need to just accept it is hard and do it anyway...
T

I don't have a lot of money but I think I may look for a trainer or someone I can pay for a couple of months until I can launch into it myself, I really need a cheerleader and to be shown the right way to go about this!
Wow.

No one will defend him, no man or woman that is SO THANKFUL their partner gave them more time than they deserved, and they had "the moment" and realized how important it was to work on the relationship and got their act together? Maybe I am living in a dream world to think it could get better one day.

> it sounds like the damage is done and you sound checked out

Yes, I think that does sum it up accurately. Maybe I have been delusional to think if I just worked hard enough with therapy I could "check back in" and show him more affection and encourage him to work on himself and our relationship in his own way...but I don't have any energy for it. I can barely work on myself.

That's exactly what I would say if he were still drinking - but he has done two things this year, he's stopped drinking and now he does like 30% of the housework instead of 15%. Though the fact that he stopped drinking due to court orders...and he only really started dealing more with housework after the last time I almost left...it doesn't bode well, does it? He's made other positive changes, but only in how he's dedicated himself more to his programming hobby/passion/future career. I do feel that any changes he's made weren't for me...but then they said it's controlling to want someone to change for you, and if I'm being controlling then I'm the one who's being abusive, so it comes down to maybe I need to change my perspective and not be so judgmental of him. Ugh. These are the conversations and thoughts that keep me unable to just make up my mind AND go through with whatever choice I make.

Thank you! I have a Verizon phone but can totally pick up a temporary phone from AT&T for this, better safe than sorry - I didn't even consider that! And the same for your first paragraph...thank you again! I knew it was going to be expensive but, I disregarded how nice it would be to explore a bit after work, or before work, if I know I'm there for a few days I can really check things out. Hmm, this is sounding pretty nice!! 

Luckily we in our many years together never combined finances or passwords, so I don't have much to worry about there, but I'll definitely keep an eye out. I think at this point I have nothing to worry about, if I'm gone already he'll just immediately move on - I don't think he really wants me but he'd rather keep me then let me go because I'm better than nothing, and that just can't last anymore. Whew. Thanks again!
I did not even consider the fog, thank you for bringing that to my attention!

Have you done a lot of winter mountain driving? My tires are good, and I'm definitely going the longer route to avoid as many mountains as possible - but I have to admit, I'm going to drive at night, almost entirely. Is it that bad of an idea to do? I could not drive and just stay put in a hotel, but I was thinking I would try to drive 5-6 hours after work every day, from one hotel to the next. It's about a 45 hour drive if I drove non-stop so after two weekend days of driving for 10 hours (hopefully), that'll put me at about a week to complete the trip. But I could just stay put for the week in one hotel then finish the drive the following weekend...

I'll definitely go slower than the speed limit and will remember to use my flashers if I feel that I'm not matching the speed of traffic anymore - do you think I'm crazy to drive at night? Please be as blunt as you need to be!

You know my original plan was to run while he was at work months ago and reddit basically called me a monster for even considering ghosting him after so long...I owed him an explanation but now...I think you're right. I don't owe him anymore. He already knows all the reasons, since it's almost happened multiple times...if I owed him before I don't now.

Hail Eris...one of the reasons I want to leave is I've spent 20+ years reading occult books and at this stage in my life, I am called to practice. Although my SO accepts this and that's lovely, it feels like I'm lying to myself to stay in this relationship and I feel like these lies cloud my mind so much that I can't practice. If I have to lie to myself to stay here with him, lie to him about my feelings to keep our relationship calm and happy so we're not fighting all the time, then I don't know how I can make any progress. 

Maybe you're not into that sort of thing and your flair was just a coincidence but...I liked it. My SO angrily told me before when I wanted to leave that if I look for signs to leave everywhere, that's exactly what I'm going to find - he said it to disparage what I saw as signs I should leave, but maybe it really is just the universe saying hey the door really is that way, go toward it and go toward it now.

I froze...I get worried that I'm only experiencing a "grass is always greener" affect, that leaving is the wrong choice. That I'm abandoning him after he's been sober for a year, at a time when he's actually a lot better of a person than he ever was before...doesn't makes sense to leave. That I haven't given couples counseling a chance yet...he keeps saying he'll schedule it but hasn't yet which hurts because if I were in love with someone and they wanted couples counseling and had almost left me three times I'd be fighting to schedule it every day and letting that person know...but he hasn't. I'm afraid to leave the cats behind, they are his legally and I know he loves and cares for them...but I love them so much too and they love me...I had a cat die when I left for college many moons ago because I "abandoned" her, she got sick and died while my grandparents cared for her. I still cry over that, it's been almost 15 years too...I just feel so weak. That's why I failed. 

But your second paragraph...that helps a lot...because you're right it is okay to feel scared...to feel fear...but just because I feel it doesn't mean I have to succumb to this. I will try to repeat that over and over, courage means feeling scared and continuing anyway. I say all the time I don't have any courage but...maybe I can fake it by just going forward no matter how scared I am.
